text:
people_ops_anna: Leftover pricing/packaging questions from the all-hands  leadership will hang out here for quick clarifications on quotas, credits, and rate-limit behavior. Drop short Qs.

eng_tom: Do we support per-route quotas? Eg keep embeddings capped but allow generation to continue.

cto_jen: Yes  you can set per-route token quotas and separate concurrency limits. Route configs live in Console -> Routes and via the API.

dev_sara: What headers should our infra watch for to detect imminent throttling?

cto_jen: SDKs expose helpers but the low-level headers are: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch), and Retry-After. We recommend alerting when Remaining < 100 for high-throughput routes.

finance_john: Quick credit note: trial credits expire in 90 days. Promo credits list an expiration on issuance; some enterprise promos support rollover per contract.

eng_tom: Can we set a hard spend cap for a project so CI can never blow credits?

product_maya: Yes  Console -> Billing supports soft alerts and hard caps per project. Hard cap = block traffic when hit. For org-level controls open a support ticket and we can enforce account-wide controls.

dev_sara: If a project hits a hard cap, do we return 402 or 429?

cto_jen: We return 402 (Payment Required) for spend-block events and 429 for rate-limit windows. Retry semantics differ accordingly.

eng_tom: Is there an API to poll remaining credits programmatically? Want CI to pause before hitting limits.

product_maya: Yep. Example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/accounts/ACCOUNT_ID/credits
```

finance_john: Also note: internal dev/free-tier accounts have monthly allotments that reset at UTC midnight on the 1st. We discourage creating many free-tier accounts to dodge quotas  see TOS.

support_bot: [billing-bot] Banner reminder: expiring credits show on Console home and Billing -> Credits.

people_ops_anna: Thanks! Product will post a short guide tomorrow: per-route examples, header keys to watch, curl/SDK snippets, and how to request org controls. I'll pin the link when live. :thumbsup:
